title: One Module for the Shipped Tree

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a module that spans more than one directory, When the registry declares it, Then the schema accepts a list of paths and a file under any of them resolves to that module.
Given @nit/cli and @nit/skills, When the registry is rewritten, Then they are one module covering both trees, and every task's targetModule names a module the registry still holds.
Given the dependency rules, When the registry changes, Then no rule names a module that no longer exists and the rule loader still cross-checks the registry.
Given PHASE-4's twelve tasks, When their changed files are measured against the new registry, Then no task crosses a boundary, asserted by test rather than by prose.
